mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 81 degrees. The moon is in a waxing gibbous phase, and keep an eye out at 9:37 PM for the ISS flying from the Cross Plains area toward Oregon. Overnight, temperatures will dip to 71 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The city is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for students in grades K-12 to design the stickers for the November election. Designs can be submitted online through July 22, and community voting will open from July 28 through August 7. Also, remember to check your mailboxes and ensure they are compliant with postal standards to avoid issues during future winter snow plowing operations.

Today is packed with local fun, including the Dane County Farmers Market, plus live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can join trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Louie on July 28, or visit the Verona Downtown Farmers Market on July 29.

In a noteworthy call for service from July 14, an officer stopped a vehicle for driving without headlights and discovered a firearm and drug paraphernalia, resulting in citations for the driver and passenger.
The flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store is open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
